Package com.hkust.marketplace.controllers.buyer

Class MyDealsView

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.Node
javafx.scene.Parent
javafx.scene.layout.Region
javafx.scene.control.Control
javafx.scene.control.ScrollPane
com.hkust.marketplace.controllers.buyer.MyDealsView
All Implemented Interfaces:
Refreshable, javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget, javafx.scene.control.Skinnable
public class MyDealsView extends javafx.scene.control.ScrollPane implements Refreshable
The My Deals screen (UC7; Task 1.6): the buyer's current deals, followed by the completed ones. Each deal shows its listing, seller, type, status, terms, the seller's counter and, for a borrowed item, the due date; and it has the buttons for what can be done with it.

This is the use case's boundary (Lecture 15). Which buttons a deal gets is decided by MyDealsService (Deal.canBeMarkedComplete() and the like), and the wording is in the tested DealText and OfferText. This class asks the buyer to confirm (steps 4-5; A3), calls the service, and hands the rest to the dashboard through MyDealsView.Actions: reopening the listing or the chat (A4), agreeing to a counter (UC5) and rating the seller (UC10).
